description: Change metadata (title, description, price, categories, tags, etc.) of an existing software — no binary upload, no ZIP. DO NOT use this to upload a new build — use update_software for that. Changing title, description, long_description or categories on an approved tool triggers a re-review. Upgrading price_eur from 0 to a paid value also triggers re-review. All other fields (tags, price reductions, tool_language, unlisted) do NOT trigger re-review. Set unlisted:true to take an approved tool off the market (reversible with unlisted:false) — existing buyers keep access, it just cannot be newly purchased. Rate limit: 5 updates per tool per 24 h (shared with update_software). check_review_status shows your remaining budget. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

drm_mode.description: Paid tools are forced to sdk_required server-side regardless of this

framework.description: Usually auto-detected from the build; override only if wrong

license.description: License / EULA name shown to buyers

platforms.description: Correct the platforms when the ZIP auto-detection got them wrong

privacy_policy.description: Privacy policy text; null clears it. KO_09 rejects a build whose code contacts an analytics or telemetry service that this text does not name - this is the only way to satisfy that rule.

sale_ends_at.description: ISO timestamp when the sale ends; null = open-ended

sale_price_eur.description: Discounted price (>= 0.99 and below price_eur); null ends the sale

support_contact.description: Support contact shown to buyers, e.g. an email address; null clears it

tool_language.description: Language code of the software user interface, e.g. "de". NOT the programming language - this drives the lang filter in search_software and the language chip on the listing page.

trial_enabled.description: Enable a time-limited trial for a paid tool

unlisted.description: true = take off market (hidden, not purchasable); false = re-list

video_url.description: https YouTube/Vimeo link; null removes the video entry

name: set_metadata
title: Set Crela software metadata
